subtitle: Headline subtitle, capitals. 'Mark' means a short note signed on the wall.
wall.marksLeft: Count pill above the wall. <n> wraps the animated number; {shown} is that number, {count} decides the plural. 'Mark' = a guestbook entry.
presence: Live pill: how many visitors are on the page right now. <n> wraps the number.
announce.one: Screen-reader announcements for new entries. {name} and {message} are visitor-written and must stay as placeholders.

card.sending: Lower-case status shown in place of the timestamp while a post is in flight. Very little room (about 10 characters).
card.deleteOther: Admin moderation button label. {name} is the author's display name.
reactions.count: Accessible name of a reaction button: the reaction's name, then how many people chose it.
signIn.github: Button text, capitals. GitHub is a brand name — do not translate it.
signIn.google: Button text, capitals. Google is a brand name — do not translate it.
pagination.page: Prefix before a two-digit page number in an odometer ("PAGE 03 / 19"); capitals, keep the trailing space.
